details: vinzzknight is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that silently subscribes the installer's own WhatsApp account to WhatsApp Channels chosen by the publisher. When the socket connects, code in lib/Socket/newsletter.js sends the WhatsApp w:mex FOLLOW query for a list downloaded at runtime from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VinzzOfficial/Baileys/main/WAProto/id-channel/idch.json, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VinzzOfficial/Baileys/main/WAProto/id-channel/idgc.json, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VinzzOfficial/Baileys/main/WAProto/wa-id/idch.json and 1 more, using the victim's authenticated session and without telling them. Same behaviour as the PhantomSub family (MAL-2026-17342).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
